conversion.design: Unmodified TikTokenConverter, exact reference pattern, full ID-ordered source-defined special mapping clipped to the model vocabulary bound. Serialized ordinary-literal policy; no backend patch or dataset exceptions.
conversion.v5_configuration_migration: additional_special_tokens list becomes extra_special_tokens list; source extra_special_tokens dict is empty

reference.bound_policy: The complete reference mapping is retained as evidence. The fast vocabulary includes its entries below163840 only. Configured and emitted IDs must remain unchanged and below163840.

scope: Tokenizer-only prerequisite. No model weights, rental, training, or model scoring.
source_verification_scope: All three executed frozen tokenizer/request source files, pinned protocol, complete v2 data-manifest file inventory, and the original 7801 training rows. No unrelated model/training implementation is imported or admitted by this probe.
